documents.title: Tidewell company overview
documents.text:
Tidewell Consulting (fictional demo company). Technology and operations consulting for growing companies.
Tidewell helps companies with 20 to 500 employees plan their technology, automate manual work and adopt AI safely. We are vendor-neutral: we don't resell software or take commissions.
Location: Remote-first, headquartered in Austin, Texas. We work with clients across the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.
Business hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time.
Email: hello@tidewell.example
Best fit: Companies with 20 to 500 employees, especially professional services, logistics, light manufacturing, e-commerce and healthcare administration (non-clinical work only).
Tidewell does not offer: Break/fix IT support, help desk or on-site repairs; Buying or reselling hardware and software licences; Custom mobile app development; Cybersecurity incident response (we refer you to a specialist partner); Legal, tax, financial or compliance advice.
Teams: Strategy team (Maya Collins, Principal Consultant); Automation & AI team (Daniel Reyes, Automation Lead); Cloud & Data team (Priya Nair, Cloud & Data Lead); Client Success team (Client Success team).

documents.title: Tidewell services and starting prices
documents.text:
IT Strategy & Roadmap
A 12-month technology roadmap tied to your business goals. We review your current systems, costs and risks, interview key people, then deliver a prioritised 12-month roadmap with budget ranges and a clear first quarter plan.
Typical length: 4 to 6 weeks. Price: from $6,500 (a guide, not a quote).
Includes: Current-state review of systems, costs and risks; Interviews with leadership and key staff; Prioritised 12-month roadmap with budget ranges; Board-ready summary presentation.
Led by: Strategy team.

Process Automation
Map a manual process, then automate it end to end. We map one or more manual workflows, such as order intake, onboarding or invoicing, and automate them with tools like n8n, Make, Zapier or Power Automate. Every automation ships with documentation and a handover session.
Typical length: 2 to 6 weeks. Price: from $3,500 per workflow package (a guide, not a quote).
Includes: Process mapping workshop; Automation build and testing; Error alerts and monitoring; Documentation and handover session.
Led by: Automation & AI team.

AI Readiness & Adoption
Find the AI use cases worth doing, and roll them out safely. We assess where AI can save time or improve service, write a practical AI usage policy, train your staff and run one supervised pilot so you can measure results before scaling.
Typical length: 3 to 5 weeks. Price: from $4,800 (a guide, not a quote).
Includes: Use-case assessment and prioritisation; AI usage policy for staff; Hands-on staff training; One supervised pilot with success measures.
Led by: Automation & AI team.

Microsoft 365 & Google Workspace Optimization
Cut licence waste and set a sensible security baseline. We review licences, sharing settings, admin roles and security settings in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, fix the quick wins and plan any migration.
Typical length: 2 to 4 weeks. Price: from $2,800 (a guide, not a quote).
Includes: Licence and cost review; Security baseline (MFA, sharing, admin roles); Clean-up of users, groups and shared drives; Migration plan if needed.
Led by: Cloud & Data team.

Data & Reporting
Dashboards your leadership team will actually use. We connect your existing systems to Power BI or Looker Studio and build a small set of KPI dashboards, with definitions everyone agrees on.
Typical length: 3 to 6 weeks. Price: from $3,900 (a guide, not a quote).
Includes: KPI definition workshop; Data connections to your existing systems; Up to five dashboards; Training for report owners.
Led by: Cloud & Data team.

Fractional CTO
Senior technology leadership, part time. A senior consultant acts as your part-time technology leader: owning the roadmap, managing vendors, reviewing spend and guiding your internal team.
Typical length: Ongoing, minimum 3 months. Price: from $3,200 per month (a guide, not a quote).
Includes: Roadmap ownership; Vendor and contract management; Monthly spend and risk review; Guidance for your internal IT team.
Led by: Strategy team.

documents.title: Tidewell process, pricing and payment terms
documents.text:
How an engagement works:
1. Free intro call: A 30-minute video call to understand your goals and check we're a good fit. No sales pressure.
2. Fixed-price proposal: Within 3 business days you get a written proposal with scope, timeline and a fixed price.
3. Delivery: Work starts 2 to 3 weeks after you accept, with a weekly check-in and a shared progress board.
4. Handover: Documentation, training and 30 days of support after every project.

Pricing and payment:
- The intro call is free.
- Projects are fixed-price, quoted in writing after the intro call. Starting prices on this site are guides, not quotes.
- Projects are billed 50% on acceptance and 50% on delivery. Retainers are billed monthly in advance.
- Prices are in US dollars. We don't take reseller commissions.
- Optional support plans after a project start from $750 per month.

documents.title: Tidewell frequently asked questions
documents.text:
Q: Do you work with small businesses?
A: Our best fit is 20 to 500 employees. Smaller teams often start with a Process Automation package or a Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace review.

Q: How much does a project cost?
A: Every project gets a fixed price after a free intro call. As a guide, packages start at $2,800, and Fractional CTO support starts at $3,200 per month.

Q: Can I get a quote today?
A: We can share starting prices right away. A fixed quote needs a 30-minute intro call, and you'll have it in writing within 3 business days.

Q: How soon can you start?
A: Usually 2 to 3 weeks after you accept a proposal.

Q: What happens on the intro call?
A: A 30-minute video call with a consultant. We talk about your goals and current setup, check whether we're a good fit and agree on next steps.

Q: Where are you based?
A: We're remote-first and headquartered in Austin, Texas, with clients across the US, Canada and the UK. Meetings are scheduled in your time zone within our business hours.

Q: Do you sign NDAs?
A: Yes. We're happy to sign a mutual NDA before discovery.

Q: How do you handle our data and system access?
A: We use named accounts with the least access needed, require multi-factor authentication and remove our access when the project ends. We'll never ask for passwords by chat, phone or email.

Q: Are you tied to any vendors?
A: No. We're vendor-neutral and don't take commissions, so recommendations are based only on what suits you.

Q: Which tools do you work with?
A: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, Power BI, Looker Studio, HubSpot and Salesforce integrations, plus core Azure and AWS services.

Q: Do you offer ongoing support?
A: Every project includes 30 days of support. Optional support plans start at $750 per month.

Q: Do you provide emergency IT support?
A: No. We don't run a help desk or incident response. If you have an urgent outage or security incident, contact your IT provider; we can refer you to a specialist partner.

Q: What are your payment terms?
A: Projects are 50% on acceptance and 50% on delivery. Retainers are billed monthly in advance.

Q: Can you train our staff?
A: Yes. Training is part of AI Readiness & Adoption and every handover, and we run standalone workshops too.

Q: How do I change or cancel an intro call?
A: Reply to your confirmation email, or ask the assistant to pass the request to our team.

documents.title: Tidewell AI assistant: privacy, consent and limits
documents.text:
The assistant is an AI, not a person.
It can: Answer questions about Tidewell's services, process and pricing guides; Help you work out which service fits; Book a free 30-minute intro call; Pass your request to the right consultant; Email you a summary of the services you asked about; Connect you with a person when you ask, or when it can't help.
It cannot: Give a binding quote or agree contract terms; Give legal, tax, financial or compliance advice; Troubleshoot or access your systems; Discuss other clients beyond the published examples; Take payments or ask for passwords.
Data: Chats and calls are processed by our AI provider and stored for 30 days so our team can follow up. Calls are recorded and transcribed. Please don't share passwords, payment card numbers or health information.
Voice and callback calls are recorded and transcribed; the assistant asks for consent at the start and ends the call if the caller declines. Requesting a callback is consent to one call about the request. Visitors can ask for a person at any time, and can ask for their conversation and details to be deleted.
